Matt: ok to drop a few failing prompts here
Anya: PROMPT: `def fib(n):` (short code gen)
Anya: FP8 output: `def fib(n):\n    if n <= 1:\n        return n\n    return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)`
Anya: INT8 output: `def fib(n):\n    if n <= 1:\n        return n\n    return fib(n-1) * fib(n-2)`
Sophia: wow multiply instead of add. that's a catastrophic semantic flip for code.
Omar: any chance this is tokenization shift? sample tokens please
Anya: tokens FP8 ["def"," ","fib","(","n",",",")",":","\n","    ","if"," ","n"," ","<="," ","1",":",...]
Anya: tokens INT8 ["def"," ","fib","(","n",",",")",":","\n","    ","if"," ","n"," ","<="," ","1",":",...]

Jill: model checksum: sha256: 9f2a7b3c...adapter-weights:v1
Sophia: curious if this only hits adapter-enabled branches. anyone run the model without adapters?

Anya: so likely adapter+int8 interaction

eng-runtime-bot: CL#4982: performance kernel matmul_fused_v2 deployed to canary on 2026-03-17 22:11 UTC
Omar: hypothesis: kernel changes -> subtle fp rounding -> amplify with per-channel scale + adapter tiny weights -> semantic flip
Sophia: agreed. steps: 1) repro locally with exact kernel, 2) rerun calibration with adapter-included dataset, 3) try alternate kernel (matmul_fused_v1) to see diff
Jill: running repro job now: `ci/evals/run --model llama3-adapter-v1 --profile int8-calib-v5-seq64 --prompts code_logic_subset --backend cu117 --kernel matmul_fused_v2 --kvcache pack_mode=continuous`
Jill: also queued the same with `--kernel matmul_fused_v1`
Anya: quick diff from the local repro (excerpt): ```
PROMPT: "def fib(n):"
FP8: "return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)"
INT8 @ matmul_fused_v2: "return fib(n-1) * fib(n-2)"
INT8 @ matmul_fused_v1: "return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)"
```
Anya: so matmul_fused_v2 is the likely trigger
Matt: can we rollback kernel rollout on canary and keep investigation going? or at least pin int8 profile to use v1 kernel until fix
eng-runtime-bot: rollback requires infra approval; opened ticket INF-7823

Sophia: long term: add adapter-aware calibration in our CI, include small codegen prompt set in nightly representative set
Jill: ticket for adapter-aware calibration: MLR-339 created
Anya: adding minimal reproduction test to repo: `tests/quant_repro/test_adapter_precision_flip.py`
Anya: quick patch idea: when per_channel_scales applied, avoid aggressive packing in kvcache for adapters. prototyping now.
Matt: thanks everyone. if the rollback/patch isn't fast, we should notify customers using dedicated/adapted llama3 instances. ops, plz draft status note.
